answer_1.quote: I2D2 is a new framework for automatically generating generic statements using pretrained language models.

answer_2.quote: We compare the precision-recall trade-off between I2D2 and Instruct-GPT-3 by ranking statements using their critic and perplexity scores, respectively.

answer_4.quote: We randomly sample 1K generic statements from GenericsKB and I2D2 and ask annotators on Amazon Mechanical Turk (MTurk) to rate the validity of the generic statement.
answer_4.guideline: A generic statement is considered valid if it is a generally true statement about the world.
